# The Useful Media Co

> The Useful Media Co is a one-person media company in Chennai, India, run by Raja. It publishes The Useful Tech (the #1 Apple blog on Medium, 78,000+ followers, 3.40M views), and The Useful Life (books), makes apps (Wristkeeper for iPhone, Textlore for Mac) and sells digital products including Useful Studio.

Last updated: 2026-11-24

## Useful Studio

> Useful Studio is a Claude Code skill pack for Mac, made by The Useful Media Co. It turns 1 typed line into a finished, branded short video (launch film, reel, explainer or b-roll) as MP4 in 16:9 and 9:16. Price today: $79 one time, 20 licences left at $79, then $99. It rises after every 20 sales (ladder: $79, $99, $129, $149, $199). Runs on the buyer's own Claude plan. Studio Pro is $349. Needs a Mac on macOS 14 or later and Claude Code with a paid Claude plan. Videos run 15 to 90 seconds. It does not generate AI images or footage of people. It is independent and not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

- [Useful Studio](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/): Product page with pricing, 11 example videos, requirements and FAQ.
- [Useful Studio vs lemo-opuscar](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-lemo-opuscar/): Comparison with the free Claude Code skill that has 59 film styles.
- [Useful Studio vs Remotion](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-remotion/): Comparison with the React video framework.
- [Useful Studio vs HyperFrames](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-hyperframes/): Comparison with HeyGen's HTML to video framework.
- [Useful Studio vs Claude Motion](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/vs-claude-motion/): Comparison with Anthropic's beta animation tool.
- [Explainer videos with Claude Code](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/explainer-videos-with-claude-code/): How to make a 60 to 90 second explainer.
- [Launch video for your app](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/launch-video-for-your-app/): How to make a 25 to 35 second app launch film.
- [Reel for your app](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/reel-for-your-app/): How to make a 15 to 30 second vertical reel that loops, with /studio-reel.
- [App Store preview video](https://theusefulmedia.com/studio/app-store-preview-video/): How to make App Store and Google Play previews with Studio Pro's /studio-appstore.

## Apps

- [Textlore](https://textlore.app/): Mac app to search, browse and export your whole iMessage and WhatsApp history, with recommendations friends sent you and promises you made pulled out automatically. 14-day free trial, then $20 once until 1 December 2026, then $29.
- [Wristkeeper](https://theusefulmedia.com/wristkeeper/): iPhone app for analog watch collectors: collection, wear log and a daily watch pick. Free for 3 watches; Pro $24.99 a year with 14 days free, $3.99 a month or $59.99 once. On the App Store since 13 Nov 2026: https://apps.apple.com/app/wristkeeper-watch-collection/id6819904928
- [Tinystack](https://theusefulmedia.com/stack/): AI planner for your free time on iPhone and Mac, launching 28 Dec 2026. It builds a brain stack, 2 to 4 offline activities you enjoy that fit the time you have, and runs it while your phone is out of reach. Free stack builder on the page; app is free with Pro at $29.99 a year.
- [Watch rotation](https://theusefulmedia.com/wristkeeper/watch-rotation/): How to wear every watch you own: 3 rotation rules, a wear log, and Wristkeeper picking from your box each morning.
- [Watch cost per wear](https://theusefulmedia.com/wristkeeper/cost-per-wear/): Watch cost per wear is what you paid divided by the days you wore it, worked out by hand, in a spreadsheet, or with Wristkeeper.
- [The Useful Apps](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/): Directory of Mac and iPhone apps worth paying for, and where they cost least.
- [The Useful Apps, every app](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/llms-full.txt): Every app in the directory with a one-line description, price and devices, plus every best-of guide and its winner.
- [Best-of guides](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/best/): 39 guides naming the best Mac and iPhone app for each job, the best free pick and who should choose something else.
- [Lemon Squeezy alternatives: 8 compared on fees](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-alternatives/): Lemon Squeezy closed sign-ups on 16 Nov 2026 and stops payments on 31 Mar 2027. Compares Stripe Managed Payments, Paddle, Dodo Payments, Creem, Polar, Fungies, Freemius and Payhip on fees, license keys, downloads, PayPal and seller countries, with a fee calculator.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Stripe Managed Payments](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-stripe/): Migration Hub, from 2 Dec 2026. License keys: Not supported. Add a separate license service. Subscriptions: Card subscriptions move after 14 days' notice. PayPal ones can't. Fee 2.9% + 30¢ + 3.5%.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Paddle](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-paddle/): Managed migration. License keys: No license keys on Paddle Billing. Subscriptions: Card subscriptions, through an encrypted card transfer. Fee 5% + 50¢.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Dodo Payments](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-dodo/): dodo-migrate. License keys: Same key strings, limits and expiry. Users re-activate. Subscriptions: Separate card migration with Dodo's team. Fee 4% + 40¢.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Creem](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-creem/): Creem CLI. License keys: Creem issues new keys. Keep checking old ones. Subscriptions: Each subscriber checks out once, near renewal. Fee 3.9% + 40¢.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Polar](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-polar/): Polar CLI or MCP. License keys: Import of old keys is being looked into. Subscriptions: Not yet. Polar is in talks with Lemon Squeezy. Fee 5% + 50¢.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Fungies](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-fungies/): Help from their team. License keys: Built in for new sales. Ask about old keys. Subscriptions: Migration support from their team. Fee 5% + 50¢.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Freemius](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-freemius/): Free managed migration. License keys: Imported. Customers keep the keys they have. Subscriptions: Moved, renewals keep running. Fee 3.8% + 50¢.
- [Move from Lemon Squeezy to Payhip](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/lemon-squeezy-to-payhip/): No importer. License keys: New sales only. Keep accepting old keys. Subscriptions: Subscribers sign up again. Fee 5%, 2% or 0%.
- [For developers](https://theusefulmedia.com/apps/developers/): Free tools for Mac and iPhone developers: claim your app's page, Review radar, App Store pricing, launch day planner and app name checker.

## The Useful Library

> The Useful Library is The Useful Life's site for using nonfiction books to fix real problems: habits, focus, money and mindset. Each book page says which chapters to read, skim or skip, and why. Each idea page compares what different books say and gives steps to try today.

- [The Useful Library](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/): Search nonfiction books by the problem you want to fix.
- [The most-recommended nonfiction books, by topic](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/recommended/): Books founders, scientists and authors recommend on video, counted by how many different people named each one. Lists for habits, productivity, money, mindset, health, business and relationships at /library/recommended/{topic}/.
- [Mystery Book, the daily game](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/game/): Guess the day's nonfiction book from 6 clues.
- [Atomic Habits: which chapters to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/atomic-habits/): Read chapters 1, 2, 3, 5, 13 and 16; skim or skip the rest, with a reason for each.
- [The 2 minute rule](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/ideas/the-2-minute-rule/): James Clear's 2 minute rule (shrink a new habit) vs David Allen's (do any task under 2 minutes now).
- [I can't focus for long: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/cant-focus/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 different reasons your focus breaks, and 1 thing to try today from each: Deep Work, Indistractable and Digital Minimalism.
- [I overthink everything: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/overthinking/): 3 ways nonfiction books tackle overthinking, and 1 thing to try today from each: Meditations, The Obstacle Is the Way and Four Thousand Weeks.
- [I overspend every month: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/overspending/): 3 money books, 3 ways to stop overspending, and 1 thing to try today from each: I Will Teach You to Be Rich, The Psychology of Money and Your Money or Your Life.
- [Deep Work: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/deep-work/): Read the 4 rules, skim the rest. Part 1 argues for focus at length; Part 2 tells you how to do it.
- [Indistractable: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/indistractable/): Read parts 1, 2 and 4. They hold the whole method; the rest applies it to work, kids and relationships.
- [Digital Minimalism: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/digital-minimalism/): Read chapters 3, 4 and 6. The declutter plus what to fill the time with.
- [Meditations: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/meditations/): Start with Books 2, 4, 5 and 8. The other books repeat the same ideas in new words, which is the point, but not where to start.
- [The Obstacle Is the Way: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-obstacle-is-the-way/): Read Parts 1 and 2. They turn Stoicism into a method: see clearly, then act.
- [Four Thousand Weeks: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/four-thousand-weeks/): Read the introduction, chapters 1, 2, 4 and 7, and the 10 tools at the end. That's the whole argument plus what to do with it.
- [The Psychology of Money: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-psychology-of-money/): Read 7 of the 20 short chapters. They hold the ideas that change how you spend and save.
- [I Will Teach You to Be Rich: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/i-will-teach-you-to-be-rich/): Read chapters 4, 5 and 6 wherever you live. Much of the rest is built around US banks, cards and accounts.
- [Your Money or Your Life: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/your-money-or-your-life/): Do steps 2, 3, 4 and 8. They turn money into hours of your life, which changes how small buys feel.
- [The Power of Habit: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-power-of-habit/): Read chapters 1 to 5 and the appendix. The rest is about companies and social movements: good stories, less to use.
- [Tiny Habits: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/tiny-habits/): Read chapters 1, 3, 4 and 5. They hold the whole method; the rest grows it and applies it to bad habits and groups.
- [I start strong, then quit: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/start-strong-then-quit/): 3 habit books, 3 reasons a strong start fades, and 1 thing to try today from each: Tiny Habits, Atomic Habits and The Power of Habit.
- [The Useful Reading Challenge 2027](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/challenge/): 12 months, 12 problems, 1 nonfiction book a month with chapter verdicts, a tracker and a private Discord channel.
- [The Little Book of Common Sense Investing: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-little-book-of-common-sense-investing/): Read 6 of the 20 chapters. They make the whole case for low-cost index funds; the rest backs it up with more data. Chapters follow the 2017 10th anniversary edition.
- [Essentialism: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/essentialism/): Read 5 of the 21 chapters: the core idea, trade-offs, the 90 percent rule, saying no and cutting losses. The rest adds stories around them.
- [I don't know how to start investing: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/start-investing/): 3 investing books, 3 reasons people never start, and 1 thing to try today from each: The Little Book of Common Sense Investing, I Will Teach You to Be Rich and The Psychology of Money.
- [Mindset: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/mindset/): Read 3 of the 8 chapters: the 2 mindsets, how they change failure and effort, and how to change yours. The middle chapters apply the idea to sport, work, love and parenting. Chapters follow the updated edition.
- [Man's Search for Meaning: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/mans-search-for-meaning/): Read 3 of the 6 parts: Frankl's camp memoir, his short guide to logotherapy and the 1984 postscript. The book is short, so read them in order. Parts follow the 2006 Beacon Press edition.
- [Small setbacks ruin my week: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/small-setbacks/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 reasons a small setback spreads into your whole week, and 1 thing to try today from each: Mindset, The Obstacle Is the Way and Man's Search for Meaning.
- [The ONE Thing: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-one-thing/): Read 4 of the 18 chapters: the success list, the focusing question, goal setting to the now and time blocking. The rest repeats the 1 idea with stories and research.
- [The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-7-habits-of-highly-effective-people/): Read 5 of the 13 sections: Inside-Out, Habits 1, 2 and 3, and Habit 5. The rest is useful but long. Sections follow the original contents; newer editions add notes by Sean Covey.
- [I'm busy all day but get nothing important done: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/busy-but-not-productive/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 reasons a full day still leaves your real work untouched, and 1 thing to try today from each: The ONE Thing, The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People and Essentialism.
- [The Total Money Makeover: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-total-money-makeover/): Read 4 of the 13 chapters: debt myths, the $1,000 starter fund, the debt snowball and the full emergency fund. The rest follows the same plan through US retirement, college and mortgage steps.
- [The Millionaire Next Door: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-millionaire-next-door/): Read 3 of the 8 chapters: meet the millionaire, frugal, and you aren't what you drive. The data is from 1990s US surveys, but the pattern still holds.
- [I can't get out of debt: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/cant-get-out-of-debt/): 3 money books, 3 reasons debt never shrinks, and 1 thing to try today from each: The Total Money Makeover, I Will Teach You to Be Rich and The Millionaire Next Door.
- [The Courage to Be Disliked: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-courage-to-be-disliked/): Read 3 of the 7 parts: the first 3 nights. They hold Adler's core ideas: your past doesn't decide your life, most problems are about other people, and their opinion of you is their task. The book is a dialogue, so it reads fast. Parts follow the 2018 English edition.
- [The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-subtle-art-of-not-giving-a-f-ck/): Read 4 of the 9 chapters: don't try, the value of suffering, you are always choosing, and the importance of saying no. The rest makes the same case with more stories.
- [I care too much what people think: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/care-what-people-think/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 ways other people's opinions take over, and 1 thing to try today from each: The Courage to Be Disliked, The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck and Meditations.
- [The Willpower Instinct: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-willpower-instinct/): Read 5 of the 9 chapters: 1, 4, 5, 6 and 9. They explain why you give in and what to do in the moment. The others are worth a skim for 1 experiment each.
- [The Craving Mind: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/the-craving-mind/): Read 3 of the 10 chapters: 1, 2 and 5. They explain the loop behind every habit and show it in your phone and your own thinking. The rest applies the same idea to other cravings.
- [I can't break a bad habit: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/cant-break-bad-habit/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 ways a bad habit keeps winning, and 1 thing to try today from each: Atomic Habits, The Craving Mind and The Willpower Instinct.
- [Rest: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/rest/): Read 4 of the 13 chapters: 4 Hours, Walk, Stop and Recovery. They cover how much focused work a day is enough, and how to rest so you come back sharper. The rest adds stories and research to the same case.
- [Make Time: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/make-time/): Read 4 of the 10 sections: How Make Time Works, Highlight, Highlight Tactics and Laser Tactics. They give you the daily method and the best tactics to protect it. Skim the rest for 1 or 2 ideas.
- [I can't switch off after work: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/cant-switch-off/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 reasons work follows you home, and 1 thing to try today from each: Deep Work, Rest and Make Time.
- [Broke Millennial: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/broke-millennial/): Read 6 of the 19 chapters: budgeting, picking accounts, credit card minimums, paying off debt, paying yourself first and negotiating pay. They fix the monthly basics. Save the rest for when that part of life comes up.
- [Thinking, Fast and Slow: which parts to read](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/thinking-fast-and-slow/): Read 3 of the 5 parts: Two Systems, Heuristics and Biases, and Choices. They explain the 2 ways you think and the errors behind most bad decisions. The book is long and dense, so skim the rest.
- [I live paycheck to paycheck: 3 fixes](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/paycheck-to-paycheck/): 3 nonfiction books, 3 reasons the money runs out before payday, and 1 thing to try today from each: The Total Money Makeover, Broke Millennial and The Psychology of Money.
- [Books](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/books/): Every book in the Library, sorted by area, with its verdict or fix.
- [Ideas](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/ideas/): Single ideas from nonfiction books, each with 1 thing to try today.
- Area hubs: [Habits](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/habits/), [Focus](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/focus/), [Money](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/money/), [Mindset](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/mindset/).
- [Problems](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/problems/): Every problem page: 3 fixes from 3 nonfiction books each.
- [About the Library](https://theusefulmedia.com/library/about/): Who writes it (Raja, 70+ nonfiction books a year) and how verdicts are made.
